figures.name: Hibil Ziwa

ability.name: Living Water Descent
ability.description: Descend and return: this card can be destroyed and returns next turn at full HP.

figures.description: The greatest Mandaean light being who descended to the underworld to redeem souls and returned triumphant.

figures.name: Ptahil

ability.name: Material World
ability.description: Reshape the field: choose and reset any three stat values on the field.

figures.description: The third uthra who was tasked with creating the material world but required help from demonic forces to complete it.

figures.name: Ruha

ability.name: Spirit Wind
ability.description: Shift all positions on the field; remove all debuffs and rebuffs simultaneously.

figures.description: The ambiguous holy spirit who stands between light and darkness, creating both good and evil in the material world.

figures.name: Manda d-Hiia

ability.name: Gnosis of Life
ability.description: Grant all allies complete knowledge of enemy abilities for 2 turns.

figures.description: The personification of divine knowledge itself, the knowing of life, who gives Mandaeanism its name.

figures.name: Shitil

ability.name: First Prayer
ability.description: Guarantee the next ally ability succeeds; grant +2 wisdom to all ancestors.

figures.description: The righteous son of Adam who prays at the cosmic treasury and whose righteousness opens divine channels.

figures.name: Abatur

ability.name: Scales of Truth
ability.description: Weigh all enemies: the one with lowest righteousness (wisdom) loses 4 to all stats.

figures.description: The Mandaean judge of the dead who sits at the entrance to the underworld and weighs souls on scales.

figures.name: Ur

ability.name: Outer Darkness
ability.description: Create a darkness zone: light abilities deal 2 less damage for 2 turns.

figures.description: Lord of the outer darkness who rules the realm of chaos beyond the material world.

figures.name: Anosh-Uthra

ability.name: Healing Uthra
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; remove all disease effects from allies.

figures.description: The life uthra sent to help humanity who walks among humans performing healing miracles.

figures.name: Sam Ziwa

ability.name: Pure Light
ability.description: Purify one ally: remove all dark and chaos effects; grant +2 magic.

figures.description: A pure light being (uthra) who guards the celestial worlds and aids in the purification of souls.

figures.name: Kushta

ability.name: Handshake of Truth
ability.description: Your side cannot use deceptive abilities; enemy abilities based on deception auto-fail.

figures.description: The personification of divine truth whose name is exchanged in the Mandaean greeting of clasped hands.

figures.name: Leviathan (Mandaean)

ability.name: Dark Coil
ability.description: Reduce all ally and enemy max HP by 2; this card gains +2 defense from the coiling.

figures.description: The great serpent encircling the material world who holds the darkness at the edges of creation.

figures.name: Shdum

ability.name: Affliction
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's power by 3 for 2 turns from demonic pressure.

figures.description: The minor demons who afflict the material world and must be expelled through ritual and the power of living water.

figures.name: Bhaq-Ziwa

ability.name: Radiant Aura
ability.description: Grant one ally a radiant shield: they absorb 4 damage before it reaches them.

figures.description: A radiant uthra of the light world whose beauty is described in Mandaean hymns of the celestial realm.

figures.name: First Life (Hayyi Rabbi)

ability.name: Great Life
ability.description: All life and light effects on the field gain +2 power this turn.

figures.description: The unknowable First Life (Great Living God) from whom all Mandaean divine beings ultimately emanate.

figures.name: Yushamin

ability.name: Transgressor's Power
ability.description: Deal 3 damage; this card is then weakened by 1 to all stats from the cost of transgression.

figures.description: The second uthra who transgressed the divine mandate and was bound, becoming a cautionary figure.

figures.name: Cosmic Masbuta

ability.name: Living Water Rite
ability.description: Remove all darkness from one ally; restore 3 HP through the power of the flowing water.

figures.description: The spirit of the Mandaean baptism performed in flowing water (masbuta) for purification and renewal.

figures.name: Dinanukht

ability.name: Half Book
ability.description: Read one enemy ability before it is used; reduce its power by 2.

figures.description: The mysterious half-human half-book being who sits at the boundary between two worlds reading all knowledge.

figures.name: Soul Bird

ability.name: Soul Flight
ability.description: Any ally can escape one incoming attack by briefly taking bird form.

figures.description: The bird form the soul takes during its ascent through the underworld levels to the world of light.

figures.name: Zodiac Demon

ability.name: Astral Trap
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's speed by 3 as they are caught in astral chains.

figures.description: The zodiac demons who guard the astral levels between earth and the light world, trapping ascending souls.

figures.name: Nasiruta Priest

ability.name: Hidden Knowledge
ability.description: Gain knowledge: look at two face-down enemy cards.

figures.description: The Mandaean priestly keeper of nasiruta (secret knowledge) who guards the sacred texts and rituals.
